info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Banking It Management Systems Help Desk By Systems Help Desk Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update the configurations and details of a specific Banking IT Management Systems Help Desk by its unique identifier. By making a PUT request to the designated endpoint, clients can modify existing help desk records to reflect the latest information and operational changes. This is particularly useful for IT administrators and support teams who need to ensure that help desk resources are accurately represented in their systems. Typical use cases include updating contact information, service availability, and system management attributes.

put.summary: Update the support ticket for the specified system help desk.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the support ticket associated with the system help desk resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request body contains valid information to modify the ticket appropriately.
